messages:
ana: FYI vendor sandbox shows a perf/regression after driver 535.12 -> 536.0 in the marketplace image. Repro steps + basic logs below — want alignment with NV before our GA announcement.
ryan_eng: can you paste the exact repro command? /cc @li_hw
ana: repro: `docker run --gpus all redwood/gpu-test:marketplace-latest --model gpt-small --seq 2048` then `pytest tests/inference_regress.py::test_sequence_perf`. Result: ~30% token/sec drop and occasional OOM on p3x2. Snippet of stderr: `CUDA error: out of memory at kv_cache_alloc`
li_hw: thanks — will try to reproduce on AMD/ROCm nodes. tagging vendor bot so NV can chime in.
nv_partner_bot: vendor note: driver 536.0 has a known kernel_param regression affecting muxed PCIe configs on some AMIs. Workaround: set `nv_disable_mux=true` or pin back to 535.12. Tracking link: https://nv.example.com/536-issues
sophie_pm: this blocks the marketplace launch next Tue unless we have a mitigation. Can we pin images + add a compatibility note in docs? :worried_face:
ryan_eng: proposal:
1) Pin marketplace AMI and hosted images to driver 535.12 in all regions (fast).
2) Run a controlled canary of 536.0 in one AZ with extra telemetry + automatic rollback.
3) Vendor to produce a hotfix/patch or clear by EOD tomorrow.
4) Hold joint announcement until canary clears.
Thoughts?
ana: I agree. I'll open the AMI pin PR and add a short note to marketplace docs.
li_hw: test matrix I'll run: CUDA 11.8 & 12.0 x drivers {535.12,536.0} x seq lengths {512,2048} x batch {1,8}. Will post perf tables and flamegraphs here.
sophie_pm: I'll draft partner comms + rollback wording and loop in legal. Draft by EOD, ping me if wording needs to mention SLA windows.
ryan_eng: I'll wire up the canary infra and add an alert that auto-kills the 536.0 fleet on error rate > 3% or latency +50% over baseline.
ana: action items summary (copy to partner):
- ana: open AMI pin PR + marketplace docs compatibility note
- ryan_eng: canary + telemetry + rollback switch
- li_hw: run tests across matrix and upload artifacts
- nv_partner_bot / NV: confirm hotfix ETA or provide repro ack
- sophie_pm: comms draft for partner & marketing
Please react with :thumbsup: when you've started.
ryan_eng: :thumbsup:
li_hw: starting tests now, will update by noon.
